timeline.summary: Capillary Technologies completed the acquisition of Session M Inc. and its subsidiary Session M Czech Republic s.r.o. on May 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹191.35 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹43.36 Cr.
Capillary Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹191.35 Cr and PAT of ₹43.36 Cr.
Capillary Technologies India Limited shared the earnings conference call recording with analysts/investors on May 06, 2026, via its website.
Capillary Technologies filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 on May 6, 2026.
Capillary Technologies reported Q4 FY26 revenue of ₹191.35 Cr and guided for FY27 revenue of ₹1,000–1,050 Cr following the closing of the SessionM acquisition.
Capillary Technologies hosted its Analyst and Investor Day on May 14, 2026, guiding for FY27 revenue of ₹1,065 Cr.
Capillary Technologies appointed Bill Swift as President, Americas to lead sales, delivery, and client growth across enterprise verticals.
Capillary Technologies received KPMG's forensic audit report on the payment fraud incident at Session M Czech Republic s.r.o.
